propositions: Capability decisions (native structured output and prompt caching) currently use provider-name string matching, which fails for Bedrock-hosted Claude whose model string is 'bedrock' not 'anthropic'
capabilities_for() must accept both model objects and lazy model strings, reading profiles from pydantic_ai.profiles.* without requiring vendor SDKs to be installed

Bedrock Claude's capability flags must be detected via profile field presence (bedrock_supports_prompt_caching, bedrock_thinking_variant) rather than isinstance checks, because BedrockModelProfile requires boto3 which is absent in CI
Claude (both direct API and Bedrock-hosted) must be forced to PromptedOutput via an override table despite having supports_json_schema_output=True in their profile
The _PROFILE_RESOLVERS registry must be the single place provider names map to profile resolution functions, eliminating scattered startswith() decision branches
supports_thinking field must be added to ModelCapabilities for S5 provenance tracking, but output_mode() must not read it since thinking=True contradicts structured output constraints
